s: tri, (nAsti Bedo yasya saH .) BedarahitaH । aviSezaH । yaTA, -- “aBedaH SivarAmayoH” iti purARaM ॥ (tAdAtmyam । “kAkaH kfzRaH pikaH kfzRaH stvaBedaH pikakAkayoH । vasante samupAyAte kAkaH kAkaH pikaH pikaH” ॥ iti nItiratne । “Bede'pyaBedaH sambanDe sambanDastadviparyyayO” । iti sAhityadarpaRe .)
v: pu॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । BedABAve Ekye “gatayoraBedamiti sEnyayostayoH” mAGaH “aBedaH SivarAmayoH” purA॰ “ralayordalayoScEva jayayorbavayorapi । SasayorRanayoScAnte savisargAvisargayoH । savindukAvindukayoH syAdaBedena kalpanam” AlaNkArikAH “guRaguRinoH kriyAkriyAvatoScABeda” iti sAMKyAdayaH । aBedaSca BedABAva iti bahavaH । tAdAtmyamiti tu sANKyAdayaH । tAdAtmyaYca tatsattvaniyatasattAkatvaM tena guRaguRinoH kriyAkriyAvatorapi tAdAtmya guRakriyayordravyaniyatasattAkatvAt ataeva vedAntapariBAzAyoma satyEkye miToBedasta dAtmyamityuktaM dravyaguRayormiToBedasattve'pi tatsattvaniyatasattAkatvAt taTAtvam ।
m: अ-भेद m. non-fracture, compactness, closeness of array, RPrāt. &c.
absence of difference or distinction, identity
अ-भेद mfn. not different, identical, VP.
a: अभेद — a. 1 Undivided. --2 Identical, same, alike; तयोरभेदप्रतिपत्तिरस्ति मे Bh. 3. v. l. --दः 1 Absence of difference or distinction, identity, sameness; तद्रूपकमभेदो य उपमानोपमेययोः K. P. 10, Śi. 13. 25. --2 Close union; इच्छतां सह वधूभिरभेदं Ki. 9. 13; H. 3. 79; आशास्महे विग्रहयोरभेदं Bh. 1. 24.

m: अ-भेदक mfn. not dividing, not causing any distinction, Pat.

s: klIM, (BettuM na Sakyate, Bid + SakyArTe Ryat, naYsamAsaH .) hIrakaM । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ aBedanIyavastuni tri । yaTA, -- “astrARyanekarUpARi taTABedyaYca daMSanaM” । iti devImAhAtmyaM ॥
v: tri॰ BettuM Sakyate Bida--SakyArTe Ryat na॰ ta॰ । 1 BettumaSakye “aBedyakavacaM daDe” BA॰ dro॰ pa॰ । 2 hIrake na॰ tasya kenApi DAtunA BettumaSakyatvAt taTAtvam ।
m: अ-भेद्य mfn. not to be divided or broken or pierced
not to be betrayed (as a secret formula), BhP.
a: अभेद्य, अभैदिक — a. 1 Not to be divided, broken or pierced through, impenetrable. --2 Indivisible. --द्यं A diamond.

m: अ-भेद्य—ता, f. or अ-भेद्य—त्व, n. [R.] indivisibility, impenetrability.
